state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The code lens now shows the hierarchy beside the reference count. A class something extends gets `N subclasses`, and an interface `N implementations`. A method names the nearest method it overrides up each edge (`overrides Base::name, Named::name`) and counts every method below that overrides it (`N overrides`). A hierarchy lens is written only where it has something to say. `SymbolIndex::overridden` and `SymbolIndex::overriders` in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/index.rs` walk the edges, `hierarchy_lenses` in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/server.rs` writes the titles, and three new cases under `tests/lsp/lens/` freeze them. Gap `the-code-lens-shows-only-a-reference-count` is deleted.

**No session stops on `BLOCKED` before the goal end.** A question for the user goes in the goal prose's § *Questions for the user at the goal end*, and the session carries on. Three questions are there.

**An unused `use` needs the resolver, not only the index.** The index records uses from expressions and `extends`/`implements` clauses only, so a class named only in a type annotation has no occurrence. Dimming a `use` from the index alone would grey out an import a parameter type needs. The resolver in `crates/nvs-hir/src/resolve.rs:120` is where a `use` is read, and it keeps no record of which imports resolved a name.

`crates/nvs-cli/tests/footprint.rs:71` failed once beside the other test binaries and passed alone. Not chased.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`. That is expected: it leaves with goal `ci-green`'s record in Stage 6, and nobody pushes for it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names 20 gaps in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-types`, `nvs-runtime` and `website`.

Add a `diagnostics` `.lspt` case with an import a parameter type uses (not dimmed) beside one nothing uses (dimmed), then delete the gap record.
